records.meaning: Tenant-scoped read observation of upload session state; the result does not claim artifact finality or permit a follow-on command without current authorization.
Tenant-scoped read observation of an artifact identity; absence or unknown state is not treated as successful retrieval or permission for downstream use.

A validated and policy-admitted request may create a job request; the source does not assert complete rights/consent guards, provider dispatch, or completed effect.
Replay binding is scoped by tenant, principal and idempotency key to the canonical full request; mismatched payload is rejected without mutation, with retention while the effect remains reconcilable.
New chunks use contiguous next-index sequencing; a lost acknowledgement leaves outcome unknown and prohibits automatic replay; a prior index is acknowledged only from a matching persisted receipt.
Completion is scoped to the existing upload identity, returns the original artifact identity after reconciliation, and does not invent request-body idempotency or a second artifact on retry.

Accepted definition-only caller-scoped execution-reference lineage query: exact opaque reference resolves only to one canonical ProcessingJob or JobAttempt identity; MediaRun is excluded. Runtime and transport remain NOT_ADMITTED.

Definition-only QUERY binds an authenticated host-scoped current read to one exact job and prior attempt. Retry eligibility requires RETRYABLE, a definitive no-effect or retryable-failure outcome, and remaining explicit attempt budget; missing, stale, foreign-scope, malformed, or unknown reads do not authorize retry. Endpoint, runtime observation, and retry execution remain NOT_ADMITTED.

The job.submit wrapper exactly preserves the canonical closed preservation-and-enhancement-policy typed input, including unique rights evidence and conditional consent plus enhancement-decision references. No new policy, runtime, or admission is defined.

Accepted definition-only exact-session recovery QUERY: host-attested tenant/principal and one coherent read snapshot bind current DEGRADED state, consent/purpose revisions, lease/fence, sequence and the complete source-selected prior-effect interval. CURRENT is revision-only, reconnect permission remains a separate guard, and incomplete or mismatched evidence is UNKNOWN. No execution-reference identity, dispatch, replay, endpoint, or runtime admission is added.

reviewedRecords.meaning: Voice authorization requires the exact versioned voice profile in request, observation and any returned decision only for VOICE_AUTHORIZATION; other rights/consent/review kinds do not inherit that selector. A query binds an acknowledgment to the exact original delivery request fingerprint, artifact version and destination. UNKNOWN cannot be treated as acknowledged or as permission to retry; the contract does not assert transport delivery or delivery success.

A returned bounded context binds trusted delegation, purpose, budget, deadline and typed result references to the original request, and prohibits recursive invocation. UNKNOWN is sparse and does not fabricate delegation or result references.

Only source-validated observed values carry exact parameter/schema/version and evidence. UNKNOWN or NOT_FOUND uses an explicit reason and no evidence; missing input is not converted to zero, failure or a default.

Qualification, license, health, capability and rights are separate dimensions with explicit observed, not-applicable and unknown provenance. Unknown evidence cannot produce eligibility/readiness and this query introduces no aggregate ready/eligible field.
